haiku.problem: "The man of lawlessness" is the passage's title for the figure and is never described in plain words, so the question is unclear when asked at random.
"The lawless one" is never described in plain words, so a baker asked at random would not know who is meant.
The passage's most important action by God, sending a powerful delusion so people believe the lie (2:11), is left out, though it is more important than the detail of where the man seats himself.
